label: The bundle of internal grammar…, from In the Catholic practice, the First Vatican… and 1 more
meaning: The Dei Filius ch. 1 / can. I.1 parallel to WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE, with a typed reference relation (#1010). Given the stated canon (STMT-DEI-FILIUS-CONFESSES-ONE-TRUE-GOD) and the open definition bridge (STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD), the bundle internal grammar + grammar-fixed reference (STMT-GRAMMAR-FIXES-REFERENCE, WF-P2's thesis in typed form, open) + the WF-P1 reconstruction (STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1) fails of the Catholic practice. Each premise is needed (needsCouncil, needsDefinitionIsOwnStandard), and WF-P1 escapes by rejecting grammar-fixed reference (noBeingSurvivesWithoutGrammarFixedReference), so this defeats only a fideist who holds both internal grammar and grammar-fixed reference; it does not refute WF-P1 as such. The config's link theorems (noBeingExcludesFullDescription, noBeingExcludesUniquePureActFirstMover) show, as a schema over DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION, that the reconstruction conflicts with the nominal-identification leaves exactly where a being fits their descriptions. No premise is established; no refutes relation (#999).
